tasks.description: Implement a 'Recently Viewed' functionality that uses localStorage to track the last 5 visited car details and introduces a custom filter on the Browse Cars page to toggle the inventory view.
acceptance_criteria: Verify that the BrowseCarsPage includes a 'Recent' filter button accessible to both unauthenticated visitors and logged-in administrators.
Ensure that any car details page visited by an unauthenticated visitor is automatically added to the browsing history and reflected in the Recently Viewed gallery.
Confirm that authenticated administrators can track their vehicle views in the same manner as visitors ensuring consistent feature access across all user roles.
Ensure the filter state resets to All Collection by default whenever the browse page is accessed via fresh navigation.
Validate that the system maintains a maximum of 5 unique vehicle IDs in the browser's localStorage with the most recent visit always prepended to the start of the list.
Ensure that revisiting an existing car in the history moves its ID to the top of the list while preventing any duplicate entries in storage.
Verify that activating the Recent filter dynamically updates the inventory grid to show only the vehicles present in the visit history sorted by recency.
Confirm that switching the filter back to the All state fully restores the original gallery layout and displays all available inventory items.
Validate that the application silently skips and excludes any car IDs from the history that no longer exist in the database rendering only valid inventory items.
Ensure the application handles corrupted or malformed localStorage data gracefully by falling back to an empty history state instead of crashing the UI.
Verify that the No matches found template correctly renders if the Recent filter is selected when the visit history is empty.
Confirm that any manual or programmatic expansion of the history array beyond 5 items is automatically truncated to the 5-item limit upon the next vehicle visit.
